question: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait connects which two water bodies?
options: Red Sea and Gulf of Aden
Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal
detail:
- The **Bab el-Mandeb Strait** connects the **Red Sea** with the **Gulf of Aden** (and onward to the Indian Ocean).
- It returned to discussion after Yemen's **Houthi rebels** announced a naval embargo on ships heading to Saudi Arabia through the strait, warning oil tankers in the Red Sea.
- **Bab el-Mandeb** means **'Gate of Tears'** (Arabic); it lies between the **Arabian Peninsula and the Horn of Africa**; bordering countries — **Yemen, Djibouti, Eritrea**.
- It is the **southern gateway of the Suez Canal** and the world's **third-busiest energy chokepoint** (after Hormuz and Malacca); about **10–12% of seaborne trade** passes through it.
- **Houthi rebels** are an armed rebel group controlling large parts of northern Yemen; they captured the capital **Sana'a in 2014** and are backed mainly by **Iran**.

question: Who became India's 99th Chess Grandmaster?
detail:
- **V.S. Rathanvel** of **Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu)** became **India's 99th Chess Grandmaster** by crossing a **2500 Elo rating** at the **Guwahati Smart City International Open 2026**.
- With this, India moved very close to the historic milestone of **100 Grandmasters**.
- He had completed his **GM norms in 2022** and won a bronze at the **World Youth Under-10 Championship**.
- **Previous GMs:** 97th — **G.B. Harshavardhan** (Tamil Nadu); 98th — **S. Aswath** (Tamil Nadu).
- **FIDE** (International Chess Federation) was established on **20 July 1924**, HQ **Lausanne, Switzerland**; **Viswanathan Anand** is its Deputy President.

question: Where will the International Type 1 Diabetes Summit 2026 be held?
detail:
- The **International Type 1 Diabetes Summit 2026** will be held in **Jodhpur, Rajasthan from 30 July to 1 August 2026** (announced at the Constitution Club of India, New Delhi).
- It will discuss equitable Type 1 diabetes care, insulin access, diabetes technology, mental-health support and digital innovation.
- Its aim is formal recognition of childhood **Type 1 diabetes** in the National Health Policy and better prevention, diagnosis, treatment and access to essential medicines.
- **Type 1 diabetes** is an autoimmune disease in which the immune system attacks the pancreas so it makes little or no insulin (Type 2 is mainly linked to insulin resistance).
- **Insulin** is a hormone made by the beta cells of the pancreas; it was discovered by **Frederick Banting & Charles Best (1921)**.

question: The Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs) scheme — recently extended till 30 September 2026 — was launched in which year?
detail:
- The central government temporarily extended the **Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs) Scheme till 30 September 2026**.
- The **FTSCs Scheme was launched in October 2019** for the speedy trial and disposal of **Rape and POCSO Act, 2012** cases.
- The topic also gained attention after the NEET-UG paper-leak case, with the PM calling for fast-track courts against exam paper-leak offenders.
- **Fast Track Courts (FTCs)** are special courts to speedily dispose of pending cases; first established in **2000** on the recommendation of the **11th Finance Commission**.
- **Present status (30 April 2026):** approved FTSCs — **790**; functional — **775**.

question: UNNATI AI 2.0 has been launched through a collaboration between Microsoft India and which institution?
detail:
- **Microsoft India** and the **Foundation for Innovation and Technology Transfer (FITT), IIT Delhi** launched **UNNATI AI 2.0 (Unnati se Pragati)**.
- It is the second phase of Microsoft India's flagship CSR initiative, aimed at strengthening AI talent, startups and India's AI-innovation ecosystem, and expanding AI opportunities to **Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities**.
- It focuses on AI skilling, startup acceleration, mentorship, incubation support and real-world pilot projects in areas like healthcare, education, agriculture and sustainability.
- The **first edition** was launched in **April 2025**.
- **FITT** is an industry–academia interface organisation of IIT Delhi that turns research into technology and commercial products.

question: World IVF (In Vitro Fertilisation) Day is observed every year on which date?
detail:
- **World IVF Day (World Embryologist Day)** is observed every year on **25 July**.
- It honours the historic achievement of **IVF**, raises awareness about infertility, and promotes safe and accessible fertility care.
- **History:** on **25 July 1978**, **Louise Brown** was born in England — the world's first baby born through IVF.
- **Note:** **Income Tax Day** is observed in India on **24 July**, marking the introduction of income tax by **Sir James Wilson in 1860**.

question: In terms of broad gauge railway electrification, India has become which most electrified railway network in the world?
detail:
- **Indian Railways** completed **99.6% electrification** of its **Broad Gauge (BG) network**, making India the world's **second most electrified railway network** after **Switzerland (100%)**.
- Per the **UIC (International Union of Railways) report, June 2025**: India — 99.6%, China — 82%.
- **Broad Gauge** has a track width (distance between rails) of **1676 mm (5 ft 6 in)** — the most-used gauge in India for main routes.
- India's rail gauges: **Broad Gauge (1676 mm)**, Standard Gauge (1435 mm, metros), Metre Gauge (1000 mm), Narrow Gauge (762/610 mm, hill & heritage lines).
- **Indian Railways:** established **1853**; HQ **New Delhi**; Railway Minister **Ashwini Vaishnaw**.

question: Where was the 2nd Bharat Green Hydrogen Summit 2026 held?
detail:
- The **2nd Bharat Green Hydrogen Summit 2026** was held in **New Delhi on 23 July 2026**, organised by **FICCI**.
- Its focus was on green hydrogen, hydrogen-based mobility and export competitiveness of the energy sector.
- **Green Hydrogen** is produced by **water electrolysis** using renewable energy (solar, wind); it is a low-carbon fuel used in refining, fertiliser, steel, energy storage and heavy transport.
- **National Green Hydrogen Mission:** announced **2021**, approved **4 January 2023**; budget **₹19,744 crore** (2023 to 2029–30) to boost production, use and export of green hydrogen.

question: Who has taken over as the Interim President of the International Chess Federation (FIDE) recently?
detail:
- On **24 July 2026**, **Viswanathan Anand** took over as **Interim President of FIDE**.
- He assumed charge after **Arkady Dvorkovich** stepped down following EU and Switzerland sanctions; Anand has been FIDE's **Deputy President since August 2022**.
- **Viswanathan Anand:** born in **Mayiladuthurai, Tamil Nadu**; India's first Grandmaster **(1988)**; a **5-time World Chess Champion** (2000, 2007, 2008, 2010, 2012) and two-time World Rapid Champion.
- **Honours:** first recipient of the **Khel Ratna (1991–92)**; Padma Shri (1988), Padma Bhushan (2001), Padma Vibhushan (2008).
- **Books:** *My Best Games of Chess* and *Mind Master (2019)*.

question: What is the new name of the Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme of Tamil Nadu?
detail:
- The **Tamil Nadu** government renamed the **Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme** as the **Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme**.
- Launched in **2022** for Classes 1–5 students in government primary schools, it provides nutritious breakfast before school to reduce hunger, malnutrition and anaemia.
- **Expansion:** the scheme will now cover **Classes 6 to 8** in government and government-aided schools, effective **17 September 2026 (Periyar E.V. Ramasamy Jayanti)**; **₹217.63 crore** sanctioned for 2026–27.
- **Perunthalaivar Kamarajar** was a freedom fighter, senior Congress leader and former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (then Madras State), honoured with the **Bharat Ratna (posthumous), 1976**.
